pre_registration.genesis_note: wave-44 verifyChain requires receipt 0's parent to be the literal GENESIS sentinel (64-hex parents fail), so the wave-46 chain starts fresh at GENESIS with row 1 = a receipt ABOUT the wave-44 KAT chain (inputs = sha256 of kat/chain.jsonl bytes, output = the KAT tip e4226c88…) — the wave-44 tip is anchored BY CONTENT, not by parent field

claims.text: The wave-46 rollup chain (>= 8 receipts, one per rollup target, row 1 = the wave-44 KAT anchor receipt at parent GENESIS) verifies end-to-end with the UNMODIFIED wave-44 grammar: node ../../wave44/witness-grammar/verify.mjs receipts/rollup-chain.jsonl --expect-tip=<pinned tip> exits 0 with ok=true; the wave-46 tip is recorded in receipts/rollup-chain.tip and receipts/run-receipt.json.

claims.text: Every negative control FAILS CLOSED: (N1) one tampered byte in the qthe e_q10 chain bytes -> stone walker ok=false; (N2) wrong expected tip on good chain bytes -> walker ok=false; (N3) one tampered byte in a fixture copy -> fixture manifest check fails; (N4) one tampered byte in the crab-traps 44-a artifact copy -> artifact pin check fails; (N5) one tampered byte inside a wave-46 receipt -> wave-44 verify CLI exits non-zero; (N6) tampered LAST wave-46 receipt vs the pinned tip -> CLI exits non-zero (tip pin catches it); (N7) deleted (skipped) middle receipt -> CLI exits non-zero.
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff all 7 negatives fail (walker ok=false or CLI exit != 0) with a locating error; else FAIL naming the escape

claims.text: Rollup tip reproducibility, defined HONESTLY: receipts embed wall-clock ts (ISO-8601), which is the ONLY non-deterministic field. Re-running the rollup (same pins, same repo bytes) yields a chain whose receipts are byte-identical to the official run's after normalizing every ts field to a fixed value; the claims, tips, shas, link counts, digests and parents must be byte-identical. (A naive full-byte diff WILL differ — only in ts bytes; that is declared, not hidden.)
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff ts-normalized official chain == ts-normalized repro chain byte-for-byte; else FAIL with the first differing line
